question: What Are the Types of Vacuum Measurement Gauges?
body_html:
Vacuum measurement needs different gauges because no single technology covers the full range from atmosphere to high vacuum.

GaugePrincipleRange
PiraniHeat loss from a heated filament1 atm to 10⁻³ mbar
PenningIon current, cold cathode10⁻² to 10⁻⁷ mbar
Capacitance manometerDiaphragm deflectionAtmosphere to 10⁻⁴ mbar

Only the capacitance manometer is independent of gas type and it is the most accurate.
